description: This source file contains unit tests for the WakeWordGate functionality within the SwabbleKit project. It tests the matching logic for wake word detection, handling of timing gaps, multi-word triggers, and command extraction.

classes.name: WakeWordGateTests
classes.description: A test suite for wake word gate functionality, including multiple test cases for different aspects of wake word detection logic.

methods.name: matchRequiresGapAfterTrigger
methods.description: Tests that the match method returns nil if the trigger is not followed by a sufficient gap.

methods.name: matchAllowsGapAndExtractsCommand
methods.description: Tests that the match method correctly identifies a trigger followed by a command segment.

methods.name: matchHandlesMultiWordTriggers
methods.description: Tests that multi-word triggers are correctly recognized and the command is extracted accordingly.

methods.name: commandTextHandlesForeignRangeIndices
methods.description: Tests that the commandText method correctly handles segments with range indices that are foreign or not directly matching the transcript.
